case.title: Cloudflare · June 2022 routing outage

documented_facts: A routing policy configuration change took 19 Cloudflare data centers offline.
The incident affected approximately half of HTTP requests despite 19 centers representing about 4% of locations.
The team rolled back the incorrect route advertisement policy and restored all affected locations by 07:42 UTC.
reconstructed_elements: Illustrative three-group representation of 19 sites and 10 service nodes
Boolean router policy and capacity flags
Simulated mitigation candidates, costs, and aggregate health outcomes
